name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages an Nginx web tier serving three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, site configuration, TLS certificates, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl security settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and configuration adjustments for replication-related settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application with Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, a Git-based checkout, virtual environment, database and user setup, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
